bibl.title: Ten Coptic Ostraca at the IFAO.
bibl.seg: Anne Boud'hors & Esther Garel, in collaboration with Christine Ayad, Hadeer Belal, Fatma El-Gebali, Muhammady Fathy, Girgis Ibrahim, Ahmed Nakshara, Adel Rashed, Youhanna Reda, Hagar Saad Eldien & Amr El-Sharkawy, Ten Coptic Ostraca at the IFAO.
bibl.note: Publication of ten Coptic ostraca by a group of Egyptian students. - Introduction (A.B. & E.G). - 1. O. I.F.A.O. Inv. OC 181. Psalmic concordance for the word "prince". Provenance unknown, 8th cent. (A.R.) - 2. Inv. CO 91. Psalmic prayer. Provenance unknown, 7th-8th cent. (G.I.). - 3. Inv. OC 99. Exercise with biblical citations. Provenance unknown, 7th-8th cent. (Y.R.). - 4. Inv. OC 252. Message regarding a church vessel. Western Thebes, 7th cent. (C.A.). - 5. Inv. CO 275. Letter from a sick man. Theban region, 7th-8th cent. (H.S.E.). - 6. Inv. CO 104. Letter requesting lentils. Theban region, 7th cent. (A.N.). - 7. Inv. CO 270. Letter about sending various goods. Thebes (?), 7th-8th cent. (A.E.-S.) - 8. Inv. OC 248. Agreement. Deir el-Medina, 7th cent. (H.B.). - 9. Inv. CO 329. End of a settlement of dispute (?). Theban region (?), 7th-8th cent. (M.F.). - 10. Inv. CO 192. Account. Fayyum (?), 7th-8th cent. (F.E.-G.).
